simple.meaning: to strike with more or less violence ( beat , fell , corrode ); by implication (of attack) to knock together , i.e. surround or circulate

definitions.full: H5362. naqaph I. [ נָקַף ] verb strike off (Late Hebrew strike, wound , Aramaic נְקַף id. ; Arabic fregit caput, ut cerebrum appareret; Vulgar Arabic snap with the finger (Dozy ii. 716 ); Assyrian na‡pu probably= mutilated ; Ethiopic peel, flay Di 649 ); — Niph`al Perfect 3masculine singular הַיַּ֫עַר סִבְכֵי וְנִקַּף consecutive Isa 10:34 and the thickets of the forest shall be struck away (on singular verb compare Ges § 145o Da Synt. § 113 b ; or. read נִקְּפוּ ; — form possibly Pi`el, but compare Di Du Che Hpt ). Pi`el Perfect 3plural נִקְּפוּזֹֿאת עוֺרִי וְאַחַר Job 19:25 after my skin, which they (Ges § 144g ) have struck off (alluding to ravages of his disease) — this! but text dubious; Bu נִקַּף כָּזאֹת Niph`al which has been thus struck off. II. [ נָקַף verb ] go around (intransitive), (Ecclus 45:9 Hiph`il ויקיפהו surround something with (2 accusative); Perfect 3 feminine singular הקיפה 43:12 (accusative+ ב instrumental); Late Hebrew Hiph`il הִקִּיף = Biblical Hebrew; also = cling to, be attached, joined to , and so Aramaic אַקֵּיף (Aph`el), ); Qal Imperfect יִנְקֹ֑פוּ חַגִּים Isa 29:1 (figurative) let feasts go around , i.e. run the round (of the year). Hiph`il Perfect הִקִּיף Job 19:6 ; 3 feminine singular הִקִּ֫יפָהִ Isa 15:8 ; 3 plural הִקִּ֫יפוּ Job 1:5 ; Psa 88:18 , וְהִקִּיפוּ consecutive 2Chr 23:7 , suffix הִקִּיפוּנִי Psa 22:17 ; 2 masculine plural וְהִקַּפְתֶּם consecutive 2Kin 11:8 ; Imperfect וַיַּקַּף Lam 3:5 ; 3 masculine plural יַקִּ֫יפוּ Psa 17:9 , וַיַּקִּ֫פוּ 2Kin 6:14 ; 2 masculine plural תַּקִּ֫פוּ Lev 19:27 ; Imperative masculine plural suffix הַקִּיפ֫וּהָ Psa 48:13 ; Infinitive absolute הַקֵּיף Josh 6:3 , הַקֵּף 6:11 ; Participle plural מַקִּ(י)פִים 1Kin 7:24 ; 2Chr 4:3 ; — 1 go around, surround, encompass: a. go around , with accusative of city, Josh 6:3 compare 6:11 (accusative omitted), Psa 48:13 (all || סָבָב ); also (figurative) אֶתֿ הַזְּעָקָה הִקִּ֫יפָה Isa 15:8 the cry hath gone about the border of Moab. b. surround, encompass, enclose , usually with עַלהָֿעִיר וַיַּקִּ֫פוּ ׃עַלֿ 2Kin 6:14 and they closed in upon the city (beleaguered it); with עַל person 11:8 (+ סָבִיב ), Psa 17:9 ; 88:18 (|| סָבַב ), + accusative of thing Job 19:6 he hath closed his net in upon me compare Lam 3:5 ; less often with accusative of person Psa 22:17 (|| סָבַב ), 2Chr 23:7 (|| 2Kin 11:8 ; + סָבִיב ), also of inanimate things 1Kin 7:24 2Chr 4:3 (both + סָבִיב , || סָבַב ). 2 make the round , i.e. complete the circuit ׳הִקּ הַמִּשְׁתֶּה יְמֵי Job 1:5 when the days of feasting had completed their circuit . 3 make round, round off (literally): חַקּ ׳לֹא ראֹשְׁכֶם מְּאַת Lev 19:27 (|| זְקָנֶ֑ךָ מְּאַת אֵת תַשְׁחִית לֹא ), of heathen rite. קוף (√of following; apparently = II. נקף , go around ).
